claim: A timestep-free recurrent sidecar provides useful local coordinator depth beyond a matched-parameter non-recurrent sidecar while the protected policies remain frozen.

architecture.visible_workspace: bounded residual around immutable task anchor; only exportable cognitive tensor
architecture.private_memory: persistent across local cycles; node-local; never communicable
architecture.memory_update: sigmoid-gated convex interpolation with tanh-bounded candidate

policy_interface_preflight.feature_capture: Resolve the frozen Qwen3.5 language body and read BaseModelOutputWithPast.last_hidden_state.
policy_interface_preflight.soft_input_decode: Text-only config: call the frozen causal-LM path with inputs_embeds and explicit seq_lens. VLM-shaped config: call model.model.language_model with inputs_embeds, then the existing frozen lm_head, because the current wrapper VLM branch ignores inputs_embeds.
required_assertions: the optimizer contains sidecar parameters only
all sidecar gradients are finite after connectivity warmup
e33 and H176 hashes are unchanged after every run
zero-scale visible output equals the task anchor exactly

shared_conditions: same task-anchor extraction and soft-input decoder
same task splits, target outputs, optimizer family, token budget, and stopping rule
same harness control plane and action grammar
parameter counts and measured GPU-seconds reported per arm
controls.BASE: Frozen e33 with no latent sidecar and zero trainable parameters.
controls.STATIC: Frozen e33 with the task anchor injected directly through the shared workspace decoder; no trainable local transition and no repeated local update.
controls.FFN: One-shot task-conditioned feed-forward sidecar with hidden_dim=20587 and 10562155 active parameters. It differs from RECURRENT by 107 parameters (about 0.001%) and has no persistent state or repeated update.
controls.RECURRENT: The shared timestep-free transition with persistent private memory, evaluated at prospectively declared cycle budgets.
controls.interpretation_boundary: A BASE or STATIC gap is an adapter effect. RECURRENT must beat FFN before claiming local-depth value. Compute-adjusted utility is reported separately from raw capability.

connectivity_stage.purpose: verify loss and finite nonzero gradients without claiming capability

primary_stage.window_boundary: detach visible workspace and private memory; do not reset either value
primary_stage.hypothesis: A short gradient window with a small fraction of deeper persistent rollouts is more stable and no less useful than full unrolling at the same public token budget.

full_bandwidth_ideas_imported: mostly shallow training with a small deeper-rollout fraction
bounded and normalized recurrent state pathways

task_family_strata: recoverable malformed or incomplete child report
outcome_metrics: previously correct then regressed by depth
state_diagnostics: visible workspace RMS change by cycle
private memory RMS change by cycle

later_corruption_ablation.execution_order: only after CLEAN recurrence has finite gradients and a completed depth curve
later_corruption_ablation.first_operator: additive Gaussian noise after workspace normalization

arms.IID: independently sampled strength at each recurrent step
arms.ORDERED: prospectively ordered corruption schedule across the persistent rollout

later_corruption_ablation.interpretation_boundary: This tests a training curriculum, not a diffusion-model claim. No corruption arm may be selected post hoc on the held-out bank.

halt_policy.reason: fixed-depth curves and answer-free stability diagnostics must establish local-depth value first

launch_order: CPU unit tests and exact parameter-count assertion
independent evaluator assigns and hashes splits, seeds, and admission thresholds
root authorizes a frozen-e33 model-call preflight
gate-zero soft-input equivalence and feature-capture probe
preserve results before considering corruption or halting

requested_resources.preflight: 1 x NVIDIA A6000 48GB for up to 4 GPU-hours
requested_resources.primary_run: 2 x NVIDIA A6000 48GB for up to 24 wall-clock hours (48 GPU-hours), contingent on valid preflight
requested_resources.storage: hard cap 8GB new local artifacts; checkpoint saving disabled for the connectivity smoke
requested_resources.network: not required after protected checkpoint and tokenizer are staged
requested_resources.reason: one device can hold frozen e33 plus the 10.56M sidecar for correctness; two devices separate feature extraction/evaluation from sidecar training and reduce idle serialized work

authorization: No GPU/model run, optimizer update, checkpoint mutation, halt-policy training, remote infrastructure, push, or publication is authorized by this plan.
